title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 13, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $20,000.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 13, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $20,000.00
  to support North Hollywood Division’s Morale & Wellbeing, as set forth.  [BPC #26-353]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and ACCEPT the donation.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to accept a $20,000 donation to support North Hollywood Division's morale and wellbeing efforts.
